mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that increases lorazepam glucuronidation metabolism, significantly reducing lorazepam plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced lorazepam efficacy; consider increasing lorazepam dose or selecting an alternative benzodiazepine less affected by enzyme induction; reassess dosing after rifampin discontinuation.
